asOfNote: Custom equal-weight equity proxies for subsector beta and relative-alpha measurement. Individual equities only — not XLV/XBI/IBB/IHI/XPH or other broad ETFs.
rebalance: quarterly (conceptual; returns below are equal-weight averages of member total returns over each window, using completed daily bars)
limitations: Not Morgan Stanley or other sell-side baskets; constituents are a transparent research proxy.
Equal-weight overstates small names vs cap-weight sector beta.
EU Pharma uses liquid US-listed ADRs/ORDs; local European share classes are not included.
SMID Biotech uses a qualitative commercial/clinical + size screen; market-cap bands are checked when vendor market cap is available and otherwise rely on curated membership.
Returns require a completed daily close for each member; missing members are dropped from that window and flagged.
